subject: general
question: **Select the option in which all the words are spelt correctly**

options.text: My aunty arrivved at my home on the eve of Diwali.
My aunty arrived at my home on the eve of Diwali.
My aunty arived at my home on the eve of Diwali.
My aunty arriived at my home on the eve of Diwali.

solution:
The correct answer is "**My aunty arrived at my home on the eve of Diwali".**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The spelling of '**arrived**' is correct in this sentence.
 
• **Arrived **refers to reaching a destination or coming to a certain place, typically after a journey or travel. (किसी गंतव्य तक पहुंचना या किसी निश्चित स्थान पर आना)
 
 
• **Example**: *After a long flight, we finally arrived at our vacation destination.*
 
 
 
• The sentence "*My aunty arrived at my home on the eve of Diwali*" is correct without any spelling errors.

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 2'**
